messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, Data Saver mode can definitely limit your internet speed by restricting background data usage and throttling performance. Turning it off is safe and won't cause you to lose any important data - it simply allows your phone to use data freely without restrictions.

Please use the `toggle_data_saver_mode` command on your phone to turn Data Saver mode OFF.

After you've done that, let me know and we'll run another speed test to see if your speed improves.

I have turned Data Saver mode OFF on my phone. What should I do next? Should I run the speed test again?

Please review the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
